name: Atiendia Assistant for WooCommerce
author: atiendia

sections.description:
Atiendia Assistant for WooCommerce adds an intelligent AI chat to your store so customers get instant, accurate answers without leaving the page.
Powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), the assistant uses your own WooCommerce products and attributes to reply to questions like: “Which size fits me?”, “Is this compatible with X?”, or “Do you have it in blue?”—reducing repetitive support and lifting conversion.

Key benefits

  • Faster purchases: Guides shoppers to matching products in seconds.
  • Fewer tickets: Deflects common “availability/compatibility/variant” questions.
  • On-brand experience: Lightweight widget that matches your colors and tone.
  • Works at scale: Built for large catalogs and busy stores.
  • Future-ready: HPOS-compatible for high-performance order storage.

Features

  • Conversational AI chat widget on product and catalog pages
  • Display links to products pages and images (with a gallery) inside the widget.
  • RAG over your WooCommerce products, attributes, and metadata
  • Lightweight, brand-color customization (no theme lock-in)
  • Simple admin settings for setup and tuning
  • HPOS-compatible (High-Performance Order Storage)

Ideal for

Stores with medium–large catalogs that want to improve product discovery, reduce pre-sale questions, and offer instant answers 24/7.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or search for “WooCommerce Atiendia Assistant” in the directory.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Atiendia Assistant to configure the API base URL and appearance.
  5. You will need to provide WooCommerce “read-only” access keys for the Sync Now to work.
  6. If you run into issues contact hola@atiendia.com
sections.faq:
Does this require an external service?

Yes. The assistant communicates with the Atiendia backend for inference. You can configure the base URL in settings.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Does it slow down my site?

The widget is lightweight and loads asynchronously. Server work happens off-site.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fix: Sync history table was never populated due to incorrect API response key (data vs items).
  • Fix: Sync log could remain stuck in “running” status permanently if the job failed mid-execution; now correctly transitions to “error”.
  • Fix: Products deleted from WooCommerce are now removed from the assistant catalog on each sync (MySQL + PostgreSQL RAG).
  • Fix: Chunk counter now reflects only newly inserted rows (was always reporting the total on re-syncs).
  • Fix: Reset Site operation now also clears the RAG products table (previously only kb_chunks was cleared).
  • Security: Reset Site JWT token is now sent in the POST body instead of the URL query string, preventing token leakage in server access logs.
  • UI: Sync status now shows a color-coded animated indicator dot (green / amber / red).
  • UI: Sync history rows now display color-coded status badges instead of plain text.
  • UI: Dates in the history table are formatted to the browser locale.
  • UI: Danger Zone section has a distinct visual style (red left border box) to prevent accidental clicks.
  • UI: Sync Now button is disabled while a sync is in progress and re-enables on completion or error.

1.0.1

Metadata update: tested up to WordPress 6.9, WooCommerce 10.3.6, requires PHP 7.4.

1.0.0

Initial public release.
